limitations: Embedded dependency metadata is file content. It does not authenticate package names, versions, sources, or the compiler that produced the binary.
Only the .dep-v0 dependency section and read-only compiler path strings are inspected. Functions, types, and runtime behavior are not recovered.

Resource guards bound the selected file to 256 MiB, a dependency section to 1 MiB, inflated JSON to the smaller of 8 MiB and 64 times the section size, and the complete report to 8 MiB. Package and dependency counts are admitted against that output budget before schema cloning, graph objects, or inbound-edge allocation.
No .dep-v0 section was found. Absence of .dep-v0 does not mean the binary has no dependencies.
The rustc commit hash is inferred from a /rustc/<40-hex>/ path in read-only data. It does not by itself prove which compiler produced the binary.
